amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Total bill amount in Indian Rupees. Extract the number only — e.g. 450 from 'Rs. 450 lunch bill'.

category.title: Category
category.description: Exactly one of: Meal, Travel, Accommodation, Samples, CME / Event, Other. Infer from context: lunch/dinner = Meal, cab/train/flight = Travel, hotel/stay = Accommodation, conference/CME = CME / Event.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text description: where, with whom, what for (e.g. 'Lunch with Dr. Reddy at HCG Bangalore').

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Doctor this expense relates to — links to today's visit report automatically.
